5267-6495-7924.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
5267-6495-7924.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1531-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-6248--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-6248--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

997-2738-4871-5075.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4153-6797--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

4275-5003-6798-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4275-5003-6798-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2946-4871-6255-6798.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
2946-4871-6255-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

193-2369-3617-4423.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter on it, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.
193-2369-3617-4423.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Time Walk if it's able to do so.

2060-2926-4222-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Traveling Minister does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Traveling Minister.
2060-2926-4222-6996.description:
Activate Traveling Minister by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Traveling Minister.
Repeat.

2440-4183-4720-7220.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Glamermite
2440-4183-4720-7220.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite with haste.
When the token Glamermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Glamermite, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Glamermite for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1491-4474-6218-7267.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1987-4863-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-4863-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Revolutionist.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3536-3949-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3536-3949-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat from step 2

2438-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

851-1308-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-1308-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
851-1308-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

972-2493-3542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2493-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying its mana cost.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer and the Palinchron token.
When the Archaeomancer and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2493-3542.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Archaeomancer instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

1563-2079-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2034-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2034-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

277-1170-4124-5334-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

2335-3143-4613-5641.easyPrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
You control at least one additional creature.
2335-3143-4613-5641.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

2146-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2724-3217-5780.notablePrerequisites: Wormfang Manta doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3217-5780.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Gossip's Talent. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1408-3055-3110-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Gift of Immortality attached to Dogmeat.
You have an enchantment card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
"Gift of Immortality" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
1408-3055-3110-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dogmeat, adding {W}.
When Dogmeat dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Dogmeat to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Dogmeat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return Gift of Immortality to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Gift of Immortality by paying {W} due to Council of the Absolute, attaching it to Dogmeat.
Repeat.

4222-4249-5190.notablePrerequisites:
Nissa's Zendikon and Freed from the Real attached to Nykthos.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
4222-4249-5190.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3899-4927.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2785-3045-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Mardu Warshrieker.
When Mardu Warshrieker enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{W}{B}, in which the {R} and {B} can only be spent as colorless mana due to Celestial Dawn.
Repeat.

1486-3297-4091.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1486-3297-4091.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, chaging all instances of "Dwarf" on Magda to "Human" or "Wizard".
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1309-1987-3075-4714.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1309-1987-3075-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
